svg.title: Gantry desktop workspace — every sidebar view, visual proposal, not implemented
svg.desc: Follow-up to desktop-workspace.svg and desktop-detail-study.svg. Traffic, Network Rules, Ports, Packet Capture, Mounts, Secrets, MCP, Audit, Local Images, and Registries share one grammar: summary tiles, one visual for the page's key relation, a dense list, and a selection-aware inspector. All names and records are sample data.
svg.text: GANTRY / DESIGN STUDY 03
Every screen, the same grammar.
Summary tiles, one visual for the page's key relation, a dense list, and an inspector for the selection. Only fields the manager API already returns.
VISUAL PROPOSAL · SAMPLE DATA
Traffic — Who is each sandbox talking to?
Share of bytes per sandbox, then every flow with volume, recency, and the policy decision.

svg.text: Network Rules — Policy as cards, not rows
Each sandbox's default and its rules, with the source of every rule. Organization rules are visibly read-only.

svg.text: Secrets — Names, never values
Secrets as masked cards grouped by sandbox. State is visible; the value never reaches the desktop.

g.text: The desktop never receives secret values.
It sees names and state only. New values are sent once, masked, and the form is discarded.
